ddl.name: sport_registration_shirt_uidx
ddl.where: shirt_number IS NOT NULL AND status <> 'rejected'

ddl.name: sport_registration_rank_uidx
ddl.where: badminton_rank IS NOT NULL AND status <> 'rejected'

ddl.name: venue_position_check
ddl.value: ("latitude" IS NULL) = ("longitude" IS NULL) AND ("latitude" IS NULL OR "latitude" BETWEEN -90 AND 90) AND ("longitude" IS NULL OR "longitude" BETWEEN -180 AND 180)
